_note: Official download pages for the mods the Printer works best with, for Minecraft 1.21.11. These are other people's mods under their own licenses; Evade links to them and never re-hosts or bundles them. Versions verified against the Modrinth API.

mods.name: Litematica
mods.author: masa
mods.need: Required for placing schematics. The Printer builds whatever Litematica has placed.

mods.name: MaLiLib
mods.author: masa
mods.need: Required by Litematica (its library). Install it too.

mods.name: Fabric API
mods.author: FabricMC
mods.need: Evade and Litematica both need it. The Evade installer already adds this for you.
